notes.title: small update 0.799
notes.notes: [p][b]general[/b][/p][p]added an acheivement for completing the campaign[/p][p][/p][p][b]balance[/b][/p][p]rebalanced several combo spells:[/p][p]	planned moves (now provides redraw instead of draw, start at 0)[/p][p]	quicken (start at 0, is now also common and reduced knowledge cost by 1)[/p][p]	twin missile (start at 0, reduced knowledge cost by 1)[/p][p]	exaggeration (gives one less mana)[/p][p][b]fixes[/b][/p][p]fixed an issue where duplicated effects could use the same game object even if they consume it[/p][p]fixed the card imp to not show up anymore after all cards are unlocked[/p][p]fixed campaign end screen not responding[/p]
